name: ProcessSafetyMocPssrTracker
tagline: Management of change for oil & gas process safety – risk screening, discipline reviews, temporary MOC expiry and the pre-startup safety review in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete MOC app for gas plants, platforms, terminals and compressor stations. Changes move from request through severity × likelihood screening, discipline reviews (required reviewers follow the risk rank), approval, implementation and a PSSR checklist with training and PSI gates to startup and close-out. Temporary MOCs are tracked to expiry with capped extensions and restoration, emergency MOCs to retrospective approval. Works in demo mode at once and binds to any collection, Dataverse table, SharePoint list, Excel or SQL table with column pickers.
features: Workflow Draft → Screening → Review → Approved → Implementing → PSSR → Ready for startup → Closed with gates per status
5 × 5 risk screening that decides the required disciplines
Discipline review matrix with comments on rejection
PSSR checklist with N/A, training, PSI and open-action gates
Temporary MOC expiry timeline, capped extensions and restore & close
Kanban board with drag & drop and keyboard moves
Bulk advance and assign owner, CSV export, undo
8 KPI outputs and OnSave / OnCreate / OnStatusChange / OnAction events
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; read-only, empty and map-your-columns states
